Scotland.example_en: My aunt posts a short letter from Scotland every month.
Scotland.example_zh: 我姨妈每个月都从苏格兰寄来一封简短的信。

screen.example_en: I cleaned the dusty screen before the online lesson.
screen.example_zh: 上网课之前，我把落满灰尘的屏幕擦干净了。

script.example_en: The drama club reprinted the script with fewer pages.
script.example_zh: 戏剧社重印了剧本，页数比以前少。

sea.example_en: We collected shells by the sea during the holiday.
sea.example_zh: 放假的时候，我们在海边捡贝壳。

search.example_en: The search for my lost keys took the whole evening.
search.example_zh: 寻找丢失的钥匙花了整整一个晚上。

season.example_en: Autumn is my favourite season because leaves turn red.
season.example_zh: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节，因为树叶会变红。

seat.example_en: Save me a seat near the front of the school bus.
seat.example_zh: 在校车靠前的位置给我留一个位子。

secretary.example_en: The school secretary printed the letters after lunch.
secretary.example_zh: 学校秘书午饭后把那些信打印了出来。

section.example_en: Dad works in the records section of the hospital.
section.example_zh: 爸爸在医院的档案部门工作。

sector.example_en: Tourism is a major sector in this coastal town.
sector.example_zh: 旅游业是这座海滨小镇的一个重要行业。

security.example_en: Security at the airport checked every bag carefully.
security.example_zh: 机场的安保人员仔细检查了每一个包。

seed.example_en: I planted one bean seed in a cup by the window.
seed.example_zh: 我在窗边的杯子里种下了一颗豆子种子。

self.example_en: He showed his true self when he helped the lost boy.
self.example_zh: 他帮助那个迷路的男孩时，露出了真实的自己。

seminar.example_en: The history seminar begins at four in room twelve.
seminar.example_zh: 历史研讨会四点在十二号教室开始。

sense.example_en: The last sentence makes no sense without the chart.
sense.example_zh: 没有那张图表，最后一句就讲不通。

September.example_en: Our new school year always begins in September.
September.example_zh: 我们的新学年总是在九月开始。

sequence.example_en: Follow the sequence of pictures to build the model.
sequence.example_zh: 按照图片的先后顺序把模型拼出来。

series.example_en: She is halfway through a series of mystery novels.
series.example_zh: 那套推理小说她已经读了一半。

server.example_en: Our server forgot the soup and apologised at once.
server.example_zh: 服务员忘了上汤，马上道了歉。

service.example_en: The night bus service ends at half past ten.
service.example_zh: 夜间公共汽车服务到十点半结束。

session.example_en: The morning training session finished just after noon.
session.example_zh: 上午的训练课刚过中午就结束了。

settee.example_en: Grandma nodded off on the settee during the film.
settee.example_zh: 看电影的时候，奶奶在长靠背椅上打起了盹。

setting.example_en: The hotel has a quiet setting beside a small lake.
setting.example_zh: 这家旅馆坐落在小湖旁边，环境很安静。

settlement.example_en: An old settlement still stands beside the wide river.
settlement.example_zh: 一处古老的定居点仍然坐落在那条大河边。

sex.example_en: The application form asks for age, name, and sex.
sex.example_zh: 申请表上要填写年龄、姓名和性别。

shame.example_en: He felt real shame after shouting at his little sister.
shame.example_zh: 他对妹妹大喊大叫之后，感到非常羞耻。

shape.example_en: Fold the card into the shape of a small heart.
shape.example_zh: 把这张卡片折成一颗小爱心的形状。

sheet.example_en: Write your class number at the top of the sheet.
sheet.example_zh: 把你的班级号写在这张纸的上方。

shelf.example_en: Mum keeps the jars on a high shelf in the kitchen.
shelf.example_zh: 妈妈把罐子放在厨房高处的架子上。

shift.example_en: We felt a sudden shift in the wind before the storm.
shift.example_zh: 暴风雨来临前，我们感到风向突然变了。

ship.example_en: The cargo ship left the port before the sun rose.
ship.example_zh: 那艘货船在太阳升起之前离开了港口。

shirt.example_en: I spilt orange juice down my white shirt at breakfast.
shirt.example_zh: 早饭时，我把橙汁洒在了白衬衫上。

shock.example_en: News of the broken bridge came as a terrible shock.
shock.example_zh: 桥断了的消息传来，让人非常震惊。

shoe.example_en: Her left shoe came off in the mud near the gate.
shoe.example_zh: 她的左脚鞋子掉在了大门附近的泥里。

shop.example_en: That corner shop sells bread, milk, and cheap pens.
shop.example_zh: 拐角那家商店卖面包、牛奶和便宜的笔。

shopping.example_en: Dad does the weekly shopping on his way home.
shopping.example_zh: 爸爸在回家的路上把一周要买的东西买好。

shorts.example_en: He changed into red shorts before the PE lesson.
shorts.example_zh: 上体育课之前，他换上了红色短裤。

shot.example_en: His final shot bounced off the rim and missed.
shot.example_zh: 他最后一投砸在篮筐上，没有进。

shoulder.example_en: Carrying the camping bag left my shoulder sore.
shoulder.example_zh: 背了那个露营包，我的肩膀又酸又疼。

shower.example_en: A heavy shower soaked us halfway home from school.
shower.example_zh: 放学走到半路，一阵大雨把我们淋透了。

side.example_en: Please sit on the window side of the dining table.
side.example_zh: 请坐在餐桌靠窗的那一边。

sight.example_en: Snow on the rooftops made a lovely sight at dawn.
sight.example_zh: 黎明时分，屋顶上的雪构成一幅可爱的景象。

sign.example_en: A yellow sign told cars to slow near the school.
sign.example_zh: 一块黄色标志让车辆在学校附近减速。

singer.example_en: The young singer forgot a line and then laughed.
singer.example_zh: 那位年轻歌手忘了一句歌词，接着笑了。

sir.example_en: Excuse me, sir, which bus goes to the museum?
sir.example_zh: 先生，请问哪路公共汽车去博物馆？

sister.example_en: My younger sister borrowed my coat and lost a button.
sister.example_zh: 我妹妹借了我的外套，还弄丢了一颗扣子。

site.example_en: Workers fenced off the building site beside the gym.
site.example_zh: 工人们把体育馆旁边的建筑工地围了起来。

situation.example_en: The situation on the icy road improved after sunrise.
situation.example_zh: 日出之后，结冰路面的情况好转了。

size.example_en: These football boots are the wrong size for me.
size.example_zh: 这双足球鞋的大小不适合我。

skill.example_en: Cutting vegetables is a useful skill at home.
skill.example_zh: 在家切菜是一项很有用的技能。

skin.example_en: Too much sun at the beach burned my skin.
skin.example_zh: 在海边晒得太久，我的皮肤被晒伤了。

skirt.example_en: She wore a grey skirt to the winter concert.
skirt.example_zh: 她穿了一条灰裙子去听冬季音乐会。

sky.example_en: The evening sky turned pink behind our block of flats.
sky.example_zh: 傍晚，我们公寓楼后面的天空变成了粉红色。

smell.example_en: The smell of fried noodles drifted down the corridor.
smell.example_zh: 炒面的味道顺着走廊飘了过来。

smoke.example_en: Grey smoke poured from the chemistry lab window.
smoke.example_zh: 灰色的烟从化学实验室的窗户涌出来。

snow.example_en: Deep snow blocked the lane that leads to school.
snow.example_zh: 厚厚的雪堵住了通向学校的小路。

sock.example_en: I found a wet sock behind the bathroom door.
sock.example_zh: 我在浴室门后发现了一只湿短袜。

software.example_en: This free software helps me record my spoken English.
software.example_zh: 这个免费软件能帮我录下自己说的英语。

soil.example_en: Beans will not grow if the soil stays this dry.
soil.example_zh: 土壤要是一直这么干，豆子就长不出来。

soldier.example_en: The young soldier wrote a letter home every week.
soldier.example_zh: 那位年轻战士每个星期都给家里写信。

solution.example_en: Nobody offered a solution until my partner raised her hand.
solution.example_zh: 直到我的搭档举手，才有人提出解决方法。

son.example_en: Their only son started nursery after the summer.
son.example_zh: 他们的独生子夏天过后上了幼儿园。

song.example_en: The whole bus sang one song until we reached camp.
song.example_zh: 整辆车上的人唱着同一首歌，直到我们到达营地。

sort.example_en: Which sort of sandwich do you want in your lunchbox?
sort.example_zh: 你想在午餐盒里放哪种三明治？

soul.example_en: Quiet music can calm your soul before a big exam.
soul.example_zh: 大考之前，安静的音乐能让灵魂平静下来。

sound.example_en: A buzzing sound came from the broken classroom clock.
sound.example_zh: 坏掉的教室时钟发出了嗡嗡的声音。

source.example_en: Old newspapers were the source of our history project.
source.example_zh: 旧报纸是我们历史课题的资料来源。

south.example_en: Warm winds from the south melted the last ice.
south.example_zh: 从南面吹来的暖风融化了最后的冰。

space.example_en: There is hardly any space under my bed for boxes.
space.example_zh: 我的床底下几乎没有放箱子的空间了。

Spain.example_en: The oranges from Spain were sweeter than ours.
Spain.example_zh: 从西班牙运来的橙子比我们这儿的更甜。

speaker.example_en: The guest speaker showed photos of her village school.
speaker.example_zh: 嘉宾演讲者展示了她乡村学校的照片。

specialist.example_en: A heart specialist told Grandpa to walk every day.
specialist.example_zh: 心脏专家让爷爷每天都去散步。

species.example_en: This rare species nests only on the island cliffs.
species.example_zh: 这个稀有物种只在岛上的悬崖筑巢。

speech.example_en: Her short speech made the hall go completely quiet.
speech.example_zh: 她简短的演讲让礼堂里完全安静下来。

speed.example_en: Reduce your speed when the road is wet and dark.
speed.example_zh: 路又湿又黑的时候，要把速度降下来。

spending.example_en: Holiday spending left almost nothing in my purse.
spending.example_zh: 假期的开支几乎把我钱包里的钱花光了。

spider.example_en: A large spider sat in the web above the shed door.
spider.example_zh: 一只大蜘蛛停在棚屋门上方的网上。

spirit.example_en: Their fighting spirit returned after the coach spoke.
spirit.example_zh: 教练讲完话以后，他们的拼搏精神又回来了。

spoon.example_en: Stir the porridge with a wooden spoon, not a fork.
spoon.example_zh: 搅拌粥要用木匙，不要用叉子。

sport.example_en: Table tennis is the sport he practises with his dad.
sport.example_zh: 乒乓球是他和爸爸一起练习的运动。

spot.example_en: We picked a shady spot and ate lunch on the grass.
spot.example_zh: 我们挑了一处阴凉的地方，坐在草地上吃午饭。

spring.example_en: Blossom covers the playground trees in early spring.
spring.example_zh: 早春的时候，操场上的树开满了花。

staff.example_en: Kitchen staff prepared sandwiches for the sports day.
staff.example_zh: 厨房人员为运动会准备了三明治。

stage.example_en: Drawing a plan is the first stage of our poster.
stage.example_zh: 画草图是我们制作海报的第一阶段。

stamp.example_en: She chose a panda stamp for the letter to Beijing.
stamp.example_zh: 她给寄往北京的信选了一张熊猫邮票。

standard.example_en: This essay is below the standard our teacher set.
standard.example_zh: 这篇文章没有达到老师定下的标准。

standing.example_en: Winning twice improved her standing among the players.
standing.example_zh: 连赢两场之后，她在队员中的地位提高了。

star.example_en: A famous film star waved to us outside the cinema.
star.example_zh: 一位著名的电影明星在电影院外向我们招手。

state.example_en: In its solid state, water becomes ice in the freezer.
state.example_zh: 水处于固态时，放进冰箱就会变成冰。

statement.example_en: The captain read a short statement before the match.
statement.example_zh: 队长在比赛前读了一则简短的陈述。

station.example_en: We missed the train and waited an hour at the station.
station.example_zh: 我们误了那趟火车，在车站等了一个小时。

statistics.example_en: These statistics show fewer students arriving by car.
statistics.example_zh: 这些统计显示，开车到校的学生变少了。

status.example_en: Her status as team captain brought extra duties.
status.example_zh: 她作为队长的地位带来了更多职责。

steak.example_en: We grilled one steak and plenty of corn outside.
steak.example_zh: 我们在外面烤了一块牛排，还有不少玉米。

steel.example_en: Workers painted the steel bridge blue last month.
steel.example_zh: 工人们上个月把那座钢铁桥漆成了蓝色。

step.example_en: I heard one slow step on the stairs after midnight.
step.example_zh: 午夜过后，我听见楼梯上有一下缓慢的脚步。

stock.example_en: The canteen has little stock of juice this month.
stock.example_zh: 食堂这个月的果汁库存已经不多了。

stomach.example_en: Ice cream before dinner upset my stomach badly.
stomach.example_zh: 晚饭前吃了冰淇淋，把我的肚子吃坏了。

stone.example_en: A flat stone skipped three times across the pond.
stone.example_zh: 一块扁石头在池塘上打出了三个水漂。

storage.example_en: Winter coats stay in storage until the weather turns.
storage.example_zh: 冬天的外套先存放着，等到天气转冷再拿出来。

store.example_en: I bought eggs at the store before it closed.
store.example_zh: 商店关门之前，我买了鸡蛋。

storey.example_en: The art room is on the top storey of this block.
storey.example_zh: 美术教室在这栋楼的最高一层。

story.example_en: Grandma's story about the lost dog made us laugh.
story.example_zh: 奶奶讲的那只走失小狗的故事把我们逗笑了。

strawberry.example_en: He dropped a ripe strawberry into the cold yoghurt.
strawberry.example_zh: 他把一颗熟草莓放进了冰酸奶里。

street.example_en: Cars crawl along our street when children arrive.
street.example_zh: 孩子们到校的时候，车辆在我们这条马路上缓慢行驶。

strength.example_en: She pushed the stuck door with all her strength.
strength.example_zh: 她使出全部力气去推那扇卡住的门。

string.example_en: This kite needs new string before it can fly again.
string.example_zh: 这只风筝得换上新细线，才能再飞起来。

structure.example_en: Label the structure of the flower on your diagram.
structure.example_zh: 在你的图上标出这朵花的结构。

student.example_en: Only one student remembered a ruler for maths.
student.example_zh: 只有一个学生上数学课时记得带尺子。

studio.example_en: They record the school podcast in a tiny studio.
studio.example_zh: 他们在一间很小的工作室里录制学校播客。

stuff.example_en: Leave wet sports stuff outside the classroom door.
stuff.example_zh: 把湿的运动用品放在教室门外。

style.example_en: I prefer her plain style to very fancy writing.
style.example_zh: 比起花哨的文字，我更喜欢她朴素的风格。

subject.example_en: Physics became my hardest subject after the test.
subject.example_zh: 那次测试之后，物理成了我最难的科目。

substance.example_en: Flour is the main substance in this simple bread.
substance.example_zh: 面粉是这种简单面包里的主要物质。

success.example_en: Finishing the race was a real success for him.
success.example_zh: 对他来说，跑完这场比赛是一次真正的成功。

sugar.example_en: I stopped putting sugar in my morning cocoa.
sugar.example_zh: 我早上喝可可时不再放糖了。

suggestion.example_en: My suggestion was to start the meeting earlier.
suggestion.example_zh: 我的提议是把会议提前开始。

suite.example_en: The hotel suite had a sofa and two single beds.
suite.example_zh: 这家旅馆的套间里有一张沙发和两张单人床。

sum.example_en: Check the sum before you pay the restaurant bill.
sum.example_zh: 付餐馆账单之前，先把总和核对一遍。

summary.example_en: Our summary of the chapter filled half a page.
summary.example_zh: 我们对这一章写的摘要占了半页纸。

summer.example_en: Last summer we camped beside a river for a week.
summer.example_zh: 去年夏天，我们在河边露营了一个星期。

sun.example_en: The afternoon sun made the classroom too hot.
sun.example_zh: 下午的太阳把教室晒得太热了。

Sunday.example_en: Sunday is quiet because our family stays at home.
Sunday.example_zh: 星期日很安静，因为我们全家都待在家里。

supper.example_en: Fish and rice made a hot supper after swimming.
supper.example_zh: 游完泳以后，晚饭是热乎的鱼和米饭。

supplier.example_en: A local supplier brings vegetables to our canteen.
supplier.example_zh: 一位本地供应商给我们食堂送蔬菜。

supporter.example_en: Each supporter wore a red scarf in the cold wind.
supporter.example_zh: 每一位支持者都在冷风里戴着红围巾。

surface.example_en: Thick dust covered the surface of the old piano.
surface.example_zh: 厚厚的灰尘盖住了那架旧钢琴的表面。

surgery.example_en: Minor surgery on his wrist kept him at home for days.
surgery.example_zh: 手腕上的一个小手术让他在家待了好几天。

surprise.example_en: Mum's surprise was tickets to the weekend match.
surprise.example_zh: 妈妈给的惊喜是周末比赛的门票。

survey.example_en: Our group ran a survey on how classmates travel.
survey.example_zh: 我们小组做了一项关于同学如何出行的调查。

survival.example_en: Clean water meant survival for the hikers on the hill.
survival.example_zh: 对山上的徒步者来说，干净的水意味着能够存活。

Sweden.example_en: My pen friend in Sweden sent photos of frozen lakes.
Sweden.example_zh: 我在瑞典的笔友寄来了结冰湖面的照片。

swimming.example_en: Swimming before breakfast wakes me up completely.
swimming.example_zh: 早饭前游泳能让我完全清醒过来。

Switzerland.example_en: Chocolate brought back from Switzerland filled the tin.
Switzerland.example_zh: 从瑞士带回来的巧克力把那个罐子装满了。

symbol.example_en: The olive branch is a symbol of peace in the play.
symbol.example_zh: 在这部话剧里，橄榄枝是和平的象征。

symptom.example_en: A high temperature was the first symptom of his cold.
symptom.example_zh: 高烧是他感冒后出现的第一个症状。

system.example_en: Our heating system rattles whenever the wind rises.
system.example_zh: 风一大，我们的供暖系统就咔咔作响。

tablet.example_en: Take one tablet with water after you eat breakfast.
tablet.example_zh: 吃完早饭后，用水送服一片药片。

tail.example_en: The cat's tail knocked a cup off the low table.
tail.example_zh: 猫的尾巴把矮桌上的杯子碰掉了。

Taiwan.example_en: We changed planes in Taiwan on the way to see cousins.
Taiwan.example_zh: 去看表亲的路上，我们在台湾换了飞机。

tale.example_en: Dad's tale about a brave mouse lasted until bedtime.
tale.example_zh: 爸爸讲的勇敢小老鼠的故事一直讲到睡觉。

tank.example_en: Mud covered the tank as it crossed the empty field.
tank.example_zh: 坦克穿过空地时，身上沾满了泥。

tape.example_en: A piece of clear tape held the torn map together.
tape.example_zh: 一小段透明胶带把撕破的地图粘在了一起。

target.example_en: Beating our old score is the target for Friday.
target.example_zh: 超过我们以前的分数，是星期五的目标。

task.example_en: Sorting the library books became my task on Friday.
task.example_zh: 星期五，整理图书馆的书成了我的任务。

taste.example_en: I prefer the taste of warm milk to cold milk.
taste.example_zh: 比起冰牛奶，我更喜欢热牛奶的味道。

tax.example_en: The tax added two pounds to the price of the coat.
tax.example_zh: 加上税费以后，这件外套的价格多了两英镑。

taxi.example_en: The taxi arrived late, so we ran into assembly.
taxi.example_zh: 出租车来晚了，我们只好跑着去参加晨会。

tea.example_en: Grandpa drinks weak tea with no milk every evening.
tea.example_zh: 爷爷每天晚上都喝不加奶的淡茶。

teacher.example_en: Our maths teacher stayed late to mark our graphs.
teacher.example_zh: 我们的数学老师留到很晚，批改我们的图表。

teaching.example_en: Good teaching made the dull chapter feel exciting.
teaching.example_zh: 出色的教导让枯燥的那一章变得有趣了。

team.example_en: The relay team dropped the baton on the last bend.
team.example_zh: 接力队在最后一个弯道掉了接力棒。

technique.example_en: Her serving technique improved after weeks of practice.
technique.example_zh: 练了几个星期之后，她的发球手法进步了。

technology.example_en: New technology lets farmers water fields from home.
technology.example_zh: 新技术让农民在家里就能给田地浇水。

telephone.example_en: The office telephone rang all through lunch break.
telephone.example_zh: 办公室的电话响了整整一个午休。

television.example_en: We argued about the film we saw on television.
television.example_zh: 我们就在电视上看到的那部电影争论了起来。

telly.example_en: Grandad sleeps in his chair with the telly still on.
telly.example_zh: 爷爷在椅子上睡着了，电视却还开着。

tennis.example_en: Rain cancelled tennis, so we played cards indoors.
tennis.example_zh: 下雨取消了网球，我们就改在室内打牌。

tension.example_en: You could feel the tension while the scores were read.
tension.example_zh: 宣读分数的时候，你能感到那种紧张。

term.example_en: The autumn term ends two days before Christmas.
term.example_zh: 秋季学期在圣诞节前两天结束。

territory.example_en: Wolves mark territory so other packs stay away.
territory.example_zh: 狼会标记领土，让别的狼群不敢靠近。

test.example_en: Open your test only when the teacher starts the clock.
test.example_zh: 等老师开始计时，再打开测试卷。

text.example_en: Copy the text from the board into your notebook.
text.example_zh: 把黑板上的文本抄到你的笔记本里。

theatre.example_en: Our class booked seats at the theatre for Friday.
theatre.example_zh: 我们班订了星期五去剧院的座位。

theme.example_en: Courage is the theme running through this novel.
theme.example_zh: 勇气是贯穿这本小说的主题。

therapy.example_en: Speech therapy helped my cousin say the hard sounds.
therapy.example_zh: 言语疗法帮我表弟发出了那些难发的音。

thing.example_en: Losing the bus ticket was the worst thing all week.
thing.example_zh: 把公共汽车票弄丢了，是这一周最糟糕的事。

thinking.example_en: Slow thinking saved him from a careless mistake.
thinking.example_zh: 慢慢思考让他避免了一个粗心的错误。

thought.example_en: A worrying thought kept me awake past midnight.
thought.example_zh: 一个令人不安的想法让我过了午夜还睡不着。

threat.example_en: Floodwater became a threat to houses by the river.
threat.example_zh: 洪水成了河边那些房子的威胁。

throat.example_en: Hot lemon water eased my throat while I had a cold.
throat.example_zh: 我感冒的时候，热柠檬水缓解了喉咙的不适。

Thursday.example_en: Thursday is match day for our school football team.
Thursday.example_zh: 星期四是我们学校足球队的比赛日。

tights.example_en: Her tights tore when she climbed over the fence.
tights.example_zh: 她翻篱笆的时候，裤袜刮破了。

time.example_en: Check the time so we do not miss the coach.
time.example_zh: 看一下时间，免得我们错过长途汽车。

tip.example_en: I left a tip because the waiter had been kind.
tip.example_zh: 服务员一直很热情，所以我留了小费。

toast.example_en: The toast popped up burnt, so I scraped it.
toast.example_zh: 吐司弹起来已经糊了，我把糊的地方刮掉。

today.example_en: Today is sports day, so lessons finish at noon.
today.example_zh: 今天是运动会，所以上课到中午就结束。

tomorrow.example_en: Tomorrow is too soon for such a long hike.
tomorrow.example_zh: 这么长的徒步，明天就出发实在太赶了。

tone.example_en: Do not use a rude tone when you ask for help.
tone.example_zh: 向别人求助的时候，不要用粗鲁的语气。

tonight.example_en: Tonight is parents' evening in the main hall.
tonight.example_zh: 今晚学校主礼堂举行家长会。

tool.example_en: Bring a small tool if the tent pole will not fit.
tool.example_zh: 如果帐篷杆装不上，就带一把小工具来。

tooth.example_en: The baby got a new tooth and cried all evening.
tooth.example_zh: 宝宝长了一颗新牙，哭了整整一个晚上。

topic.example_en: Our topic for the debate is phones in school.
topic.example_zh: 我们这场辩论的话题是学校里能不能用手机。

touch.example_en: Even a light touch on his arm made him jump.
touch.example_zh: 哪怕轻轻碰一下他的胳膊，他都会吓得跳起来。

tourist.example_en: The tourist photographed the bridge from the bus.
tourist.example_zh: 那位旅游者从公共汽车上拍下了那座桥。

tower.example_en: From the tower we could see the whole harbour.
tower.example_zh: 从高塔上，我们能看见整个港口。

town.example_en: Shops in this town close early on winter evenings.
town.example_zh: 冬天的晚上，这座城镇里的商店关得很早。

toy.example_en: The puppy chewed the rubber toy until it split.
toy.example_zh: 小狗把那个橡胶玩具啃到裂开了。

track.example_en: Stay in your lane when you run on the track.
track.example_zh: 在跑道上跑的时候，要待在自己的赛道里。

trade.example_en: Wool trade kept the harbour busy for years.
trade.example_zh: 羊毛贸易让这个港口热闹了好多年。

trading.example_en: Market trading slows down once the rain starts.
trading.example_zh: 雨一开始下，市场上的贸易就慢了下来。

tradition.example_en: Lighting lanterns is a tradition in her hometown.
tradition.example_zh: 点灯笼是她家乡的一项传统。

trainers.example_en: Clean your trainers before you walk on the carpet.
trainers.example_zh: 走上地毯之前，先把运动鞋擦干净。
